holder-quote: She heard him roar at last. His great Skills. The exiled [Smith].
effect-quote: The Skill that Dragons had once feared, but a [Smith]’s Skill. Now, the Dwarf sang. The adamantium was…melting. He was breaking the impurity away with hammer blows that shook the world. The onlookers could feel the vibrations.
